The '''Trailing Grant sector''' lay in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] and contained the [[Gandeid system/Legends|Gandeid system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The latter was the site of the [[Temperature/Legends|temperate]], low-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gandeid IV]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|320|Gandeid IV}}</ref>

By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Trailing Grant [[Sector/Legends|sector]] bordered the [[Thand sector/Legends|Thand sector]] eastward, the [[Montitian Grant sector/Legends|Montitian Grant sector]] southward, and the [[Thuldin's Grant sector/Legends|Thuldin's Grant sector]] and the [[Freestanding subsectors/Legends|Freestanding subsectors]] westward. It also formed part of the Expansion Region's [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]] border with the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="Expansion" />

At some point before his [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Wilek Nereus]] of the<ref name="TTaBS" /> [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="EAOC Bakura">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Bakura system/Legends|Bakura system]]</ref> planet [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] visited Gandeid IV, where he obtained several [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] from the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Bird/Legends|avian]] [[Diet/Legends|predator]] [[cooha]] to add to his dental [[Collector/Legends|collection]].<ref name="TTaBS">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Trailing Grant sector was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[2012]], the sector was depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in the Online Companion feature "[https://web.archive.org/web/20170806141020/https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region]," which placed it in grid squares J-14 and J-15.<ref name="Expansion" />
